question: What intense experience at the source of nectar affects even the wise practitioner?
premises: The locus is the tip of nectar
There is contact with the essence of juice
Even a wise person experiences burning
inference: Even the wise may feel a burning sensation at the tip of nectar through its essence.
uncertainties: The physiological referent of amṛta+agraṃ is not fully explicit.
plain_english: Even the wise one may feel burning at the tip of nectar by the essence of its juice.
